messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer reported duplicate model responses + duplicate billing when users quickly reconnect after a dropped socket. they included repro steps and logs, see below.

maria_cs: Repro summary (customer: JupiterAnalytics) — intermittent but reproducible in their staging: if client does a websocket reconnect within ~150-300ms of prior close, they sometimes get the same response emitted twice and two usage records created.

maria_cs: Reproduction steps provided by customer:
1) open websocket to /v1/chat/stream with session_id=abc123 and send message 'summarize sales Q1'.
2) close socket (client-side) immediately after first "data" event.
3) open new websocket within 200ms reusing session_id=abc123 and send followup 'did you include marketing?'.
4) sometimes the full prior assistant message is re-emitted as a new message AND the new reply arrives — customer sees duplicates and double billing.

maria_cs: Their simplified client code snippet:
```js
const ws = new WebSocket(url);
ws.onmessage = e => console.log('data', e.data);
// close right after first data
ws.close();
// reopen quickly
const ws2 = new WebSocket(url);
ws2.send(JSON.stringify({session_id: 'abc123', input: 'did you include marketing?'}));
```

maria_cs: Attached logs (sanitized) from their side:
"2026-03-05T15:23:12.345Z INFO session=abc123 event=assistant_chunk id=msg-01 payload..."
"2026-03-05T15:23:12.480Z INFO session=abc123 event=socket_closed code=1006"
"2026-03-05T15:23:12.610Z INFO session=abc123 event=socket_open id=conn-77"
"2026-03-05T15:23:12.790Z INFO session=abc123 event=assistant_chunk id=msg-01 payload..."

maria_cs: They say this happens ~3/10 times in fast reconnect tests. impact: duplicate tokens billed and confusing UX. Customer asks for patch or mitigation.

zane_se: ack — thanks for the clear repro. a couple quick Qs: is customer reusing the same request-id or message-id? do they send any client-side ack?

maria_cs: they reuse session_id and do not set explicit request_id in the payload. they rely on server dedupe. no client ack.

zane_se: ok. tagging eng. initial hypothesis: server may re-process cached KV or replay a buffered assistant_chunk when a new socket binds to the same session_id before we garbage-collect the in-flight stream state. could be race in stream lifecycle cleanup.

alex_eng: +1 seeing similar from internal load tests months ago but very rare. need minimal repro on our infra. can you paste the exact SDK call or curl?

maria_cs: customer used websocket stream for chat, not plain REST. they shared session_id and approximate timings above. they said switching to a new session_id avoids duplicate.

sonal_pm: can we get severity assessment? customer on Dedicated plan, impacting billing. recommend P1 for Dedicated customers?

zane_se: impact: duplicate billing + duplicate assistant messages. reproducible in staging. frequency moderate (30%). for a paying Dedicated customer this is high business impact. I propose Sev-2 for now but escalate if we see production accounts impacted.

alex_eng: For engineering intake: steps I'll take:
- try to repro on staging by simulating rapid socket close/open with same session_id.
- capture server side stream lifecycle logs and request IDs.
- add temporary guard: ignore re-emitted assistant_chunk with identical chunk id within 1s for same session.
- if confirmed, push hotfix to streaming runtime to dedupe by (session_id, chunk_id) for 500ms window.

maria_cs: customer asked if there's a config workaround in the short term. they can switch to generating new session_id on reconnects but that's a breaking change. any chance we can offer routing rule or knob?

alex_eng: short-term workaround: ask customer to include a client-side request_id per message and set server to ignore duplicates when request_id matches existing history. i'll open a support route doc.

sonal_pm: i'll add to roadmap queue and mark as customer-critical bug. need engineering estimate before we commit to rollout. alex, can you rough-estimate dev+QA+hotfix hours?

alex_eng: rough: 8-16h repro + root cause, 4-8h to implement dedupe guard + unit tests, 4h QA & canary. total ~16-28h. depends on complexity of current stream state cleanup.

zane_se: tagging for backlog item: please create a ticket with reproduction steps, logs, severity, customer info (Dedicated), and proposed hotfix. I'll link the ticket here.

maria_cs: thanks — customer is OK with a hotfix timeline. they asked for temporary billing credit if we confirm duplicates.

sonal_pm: agree we should offer credit if root cause is server-side. I'll coordinate with finance.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: staging was updated 2026-03-08 09:12 UTC, runtime v1.14.3. No related hotfix yet.

alex_eng: I'll start a staging repro job and post results in this thread. assigning to @alex_eng for now.

maria_cs: great, keep me posted. customer wants a short triage summary to share with their CTO.

alex_eng: POSTMORTEM NOTE (will update): suspected race between stream cleanup and reconnection path. working on deterministic repro harness.

zane_se: added ticket INTAKE-3421 and linked to customer account.

maria_cs: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:

alex_eng: repro attempt 1 failed to reproduce locally, ramping request rate and tightening timings. will post logs shortly.

alex_eng: repro attempt 2: reproduced on staging at 2026-03-08T11:03:22Z. captured server logs and chunk ids, suspect missing guard on duplicate chunk emission. attaching minimal logs in ticket.

maria_cs: forwarding to customer and requesting confirmation.

sonal_pm: thanks all — flagging for next weekly roadmap sync for prioritization and release scheduling.

maria_cs: thread will remain open until fix rolled out and customer confirms.
